title: Embedding Galaxy
lede: Eight thousand English words, placed by meaning: words used in similar ways are neighbouring stars. Fly to any word and see its closest companions, then solve five daily puzzles: word arithmetic like king − man + woman, and spotting the star that does not belong. Every answer is computed live from real GloVe vectors in your browser.
description: Embedding Galaxy: fly through 8,000 GloVe word vectors in 3-D, search any word, and solve analogy and odd-one-out puzzles.
